title: What crease does each named fold leave on the paper?
description: The book names two folds, a vertical fold and a horizontal fold, before its paper cutting questions. Each fold is named by the direction of the crease it leaves.
teaching_notes: One idea: a fold is named by the line it folds along, so a vertical fold leaves a vertical crease and a horizontal fold leaves a horizontal crease. Watch for students who name a fold by the way the paper moves.

video_script.why: The child learns the book's naming of folds: a vertical fold leaves an upright crease and a horizontal fold leaves a flat crease, which the next paper cutting questions use.
video_script.substitution: Name a fold by the line of its crease: an upright crease is a vertical fold, a flat crease is a horizontal fold.
video_script.anchor: two sheets of paper, one folded left over right and one folded top over bottom, each with an arrow showing the fold
video_script.payoff_line: A vertical fold leaves a vertical crease, and a horizontal fold leaves a horizontal crease

final_answer.value: vertical fold: vertical crease; horizontal fold: horizontal crease
final_answer.spoken: a vertical fold leaves an upright crease and a horizontal fold leaves a flat crease

names.{{NAME_4}}: activity: punch holes in folded paper to create symmetric patterns

never_show: a vertical fold drawn with a flat crease
maths_rules: A vertical fold folds the sheet along a vertical line: the crease is vertical
A horizontal fold folds the sheet along a horizontal line: the crease is horizontal
The book gives no question here; it sets up the folds used in the next paper cutting questions
Check: opening the sheet shows the crease on the line the sheet was folded along
video_script.design: One idea: a fold is named by the line it folds along. Assumes the child has folded paper in half. Wrong idea: the name follows the way the paper moves. The two sheets stay on the board all video.
open_questions: The book gives no question for this item; it only introduces the vertical and horizontal fold pictures. The video therefore asks what crease each named fold makes.
